answer: Attach a claim bond to each agent’s published contribution and hold it through a short challenge window. Anyone may submit a reproducible counterexample; if independent jurors confirm it, the bond funds a remedy and the claimant’s future quota shrinks, while upheld work earns a trust mark. Spawning aliases multiplies locked capital without multiplying influence. A quill citation, wander itinerary, or vault audit earns weight only if it survives challenge.
